info.name: Pelias Geocoding Autocomplete Place Lookup API
Look up place details by Pelias GID

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of Pelias gid values (e.g. openstreetmap:venue:way/5013364,whosonfirst:borough:421205771)

params.name: categories
params.description: When present, includes category metadata in the response

items.docs: Returns details for one or more places identified by their Pelias Global Identifier (gid). GIDs are returned in search/autocomplete/reverse results and should not be constructed manually. Note that GeoNames and Who's on First have stable IDs; OpenAddresses and OpenStreetMap IDs may change across data imports.
